IMPORTDIMM.description: Import Dimension Line from DXF (IMPORTDIMM). GEN-only. Reads the lines/text on the selected layers of a DXF file and registers them as a dimension line (DIMM header + DMLT items). The request body is carried under 'Argument'. The response is a flattened object { "DIMM_KEY": <uint> }; DIMM_KEY is the key of the registered dimension line, or 0 on failure (file open error, no data, or registration failed). Requires an opened project.

DXF_PATH.description: Full path to the DXF file (must be accessible by the product).

LAYERS.description: Layer names to import (at least one).

SCALE_FACTOR.description: Scale factor (> 0). Optional; defaults to 0.001 when omitted.

ORIGIN.description: Insertion origin [X, Y, Z]. Optional; missing components default to 0.

ROTATION.description: Rotation [Rx, Ry, Rz] in degrees. Optional; missing components default to 0.
